degraded.detail: The F0 canonical suite's first parallel pass reported shared/tests as test_failure; the authoritative serial retry confirmed it as a genuine (not race) failure in test_real_linked_worktree_stop_keeps_main_backlog_bytes_unchanged — a FileNotFoundError from a test fixture combining a full 40-char mock sha with a long worktree slug and session id, overflowing Windows MAX_PATH inside F0's own swf0- clean tmp dir. Fixed by shortening the fixture's slug/session identifiers (test-only change, no production code touched); the full F0 suite was then re-run clean: 18/18 units GREEN, diff-coverage 88%.
